name: Okita Aimi
source:
The wife of a dry cleaner in a nearby shopping district. 34 years old.

She is a cheerful, upbeat woman who supports the family-run store.

The main character's father, who is a widower, asks her to do their laundry as well as their dry cleaning. The main character also treats her well, so they are like friends.

She takes pity on the protagonist, who is a very healthy person. She is very kind to the main character, perhaps because of this.

[from [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/authoringheaven/mama-shibori.html]official site[/url]]
